method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: God remembered Noah and every creature with him: he sent a wind, the waters fell, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat, and the mountain tops appeared.
ideas: A strong wind sweeps across the flood sea, driving the clouds apart as sunlight breaks through onto the ark
The wind drives the last rain clouds away over a calm, shining sea, the ark in the first sunlight
The ark resting aground on a high rocky mountain ridge above the falling water
The ark small on a broad ledge among great snowy mountains, the water below
A long range of mountain tops rising one after another out of a still, falling sea at dawn
Wet rock with a dark line where the water stood, now lower
Clouds parting and a single shaft of light on the water
Waves flattening into calm under a clearing sky
Rain stopping: last drops falling from the ark's roof edge
Mountain tops breaking through mist like islands

sections.meaning: Noah opened the window and sent out the raven and then the dove; the dove came back with nowhere to rest and he took it in with his hand, it came back with a fresh olive leaf, and at last it did not return.
ideas: A black raven flies out from a small open window high in the side of the ark over the water
A man's arm reaching out of the ark's window, letting a raven fly
A man's hand reaching out of the ark's small window as a white dove lands on it
A white dove flying low over an endless sea with nowhere to land
A white dove flying toward us with a fresh green olive leaf in its beak at evening
A man's cupped hands at the window holding a white dove with an olive leaf in its beak
A white dove flying away over green hills, growing small
The ark's small window open and empty at morning, a far dove disappearing over green land
An olive branch with fresh leaves breaking the water's surface
A dove perched on the window ledge looking out

sections.meaning: Noah took off the covering of the ark and saw that the ground was drained, and in time the earth was dry.
ideas: Seen from behind, a grey-haired man stands on the ark's roof among lifted planks, looking out over land drained of water
A wide plain of drying cracked mud with first green shoots, the ark resting far off
Sunlight pouring down through an opening in a wooden roof
A man's hand pulling back a heavy covering to bright daylight
Puddles shrinking on a drying field
The first green grass on wet brown earth
A muddy valley steaming in the sun
Fish stranded in drying pools
A riverbed back inside its banks
Dry dust blowing off a stone

sections.meaning: God told Noah to go out of the ark with his family and every creature, to swarm on the earth and multiply, and they all went out.
ideas: Seen from inside the dim ark, the great side door stands wide open on sunlight and a green valley
Flocks of birds bursting out of the ark's open door into a blue sky
Animals of every kind stream down the ramp and spread across a sunlit green valley, birds rising
Seen from behind, a family of eight walks down the ramp into the sunlit valley, animals spreading ahead
A family at the open door shading their eyes against the light
Rabbits and foxes running out into a meadow
Horses galloping free across a valley
Footprints and hoofprints going out in every direction from the ramp
A child's hand letting go of a lamb in the grass
Birds scattering from the roof of the ark

sections.meaning: Noah built an altar and gave burnt offerings, and Yahweh promised never again to curse the ground or strike down every living thing, though the human heart is bent to evil from youth; while the earth lasts, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will not cease.
ideas: On a mountain slope, a rough altar of piled field stones with a fire on it, white smoke rising straight into a clear sky
Seen from behind, a grey-haired man and his three grown sons stand before a stone altar with smoke rising
A farmer's open hands holding rich dark soil with a green seedling sprouting from it
A flourishing green valley of farms, animals and a shining river under a calm sky
A farmer walks a ploughed field scattering seed, golden wheat being harvested beyond him
One landscape running from winter snow through spring and summer to autumn gold
Two small boys tugging angrily at one toy
A sunrise over farmland
A farmer's year: plough, seed, green shoots, harvest
Day and night over the same valley, sun and moon both in the sky
